blocks.html:
Lift Equipment Wrap

Do you have lift equipment or that you would like branded or wrapped? Here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we can wrap just about anything including this lift equipment wrap. Nusens has been coming to us for vehicle wraps for a few years. They decided to add branding to their 2 new Genie Vertical Mast lifts. The lifts were for use on project sites and so Nusens wanted to use them for advertising while on site. The logo which our graphics team worked on was added to a mockup and sent to the client for approval. Once approved, the 2 lifts were delivered to us for the install. This was the first time we have worked on vertical mast lifts. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has done lift equipment wrap for Momentum Lift Equipment as well.
The install was quick thanks to the proof and graphics team’s experience with other lifts. Our installation crew even had to raise the lift bucket so they could install a logo underneath the bucket. This was done so that when the lift was raised, a logo was still visible to the people below.

We have also done other equipment wraps for Nusens, like a Bobcat front loader, Click here to view our Equipment Wraps. Nusens is the perfect example of a company leveraging its vehicles for marketing. Does not matter the van, truck, or piece of equipment, VWT can add your branding onto it.
Visit us at 24 Ronson Drive, Unit 1, Etobicoke to speak to one of our experienced teams about your equipment wrap.
